impact.name: Impact model (HPM)
impact.about: Our plus-minus model: box score and play-by-play blended into points per 100 possessions above an average player, split into offence and defence.

rapm.name: RAPM
rapm.about: Regularised adjusted plus-minus from every stint, shrunk towards zero and towards last season.

war.name: Wins above replacement
war.about: Total impact turned into wins over a replacement-level player, given minutes.

team.name: Team rating model
team.about: Adjusted net, offensive and defensive ratings from our game model, opponent and venue adjusted.

wp.name: Win-probability model
wp.about: Our in-game chance of winning before and after every play; WPA adds up the swings while the player was involved.

shot.name: Shot-quality model
shot.about: Expected points per shot from location and shot type, fitted on league shots; shot-making is the points scored above it.

hpm: Points per 100 possessions the player adds to the team's margin over an average player: play-by-play on/off blended with the box score.
hpm_o: The offensive half of HPM: points per 100 possessions added at the scoring end.
hpm_d: The defensive half of HPM: points per 100 possessions taken off opponents.
pts100: Points scored per 100 team possessions while on the floor.
ts_add: Points per 100 possessions gained by shooting above the league's true-shooting rate on the player's volume.
pox100: Points above what an average shooter would score on the same shots (location and type), per 100 shots.
ast_pct: Share of team-mates' baskets assisted while on the floor.
ast_tov: Assists per turnover: creation against giveaways.
fta100: Free-throw attempts per 100 possessions: pressure on the rim and fouls drawn.
stl_pct: Share of opponent possessions ended by the player's steal while on the floor.
ts: Points per shooting attempt, counting threes and free throws.
usg: Share of team possessions the player finished with a shot, free throws or a turnover.
efg: Field-goal percentage with threes worth 1.5 makes.
fg3: Share of three-point attempts made (slow to settle: needs hundreds of attempts).
tpar: Share of shots taken from three: a style marker, not a skill score.
unassisted_share: Share of made baskets that nobody assisted.
ast100: Assists per 100 possessions on the floor.
tov_pct: Turnovers per play used (shots, free-throw trips and turnovers).
trb_pct: Share of all available rebounds grabbed while on the floor.
blk_pct: Share of opponent two-point attempts blocked while on the floor.
pf100: Personal fouls per 100 possessions (fewer is better).
rapm: Regularised adjusted plus-minus: the play-by-play half of HPM on its own.
box_impact: The box-score half of HPM: impact estimated from the stat line.
on_off: Team net rating with the player on the floor minus off it: noisy, needs several seasons.
and1_100: Baskets made through contact, per 100 possessions.
rim_freq: Share of shots taken within 4 feet of the rim: a style marker.
avg_dist: Average shot distance: a style marker.
drb_pct: Share of available defensive rebounds grabbed while on the floor.
orb_pct: Share of available offensive rebounds grabbed while on the floor.
rim_fg: Share of shots within 4 feet made.
opp_rim_fg_on: Opponents' make rate at the rim with the player on the floor (lower is better).

model_net: The model's points per 100 possessions better than average, adjusted for opponents and home court.
model_off: The model's points scored per 100 possessions, adjusted for opponents' defences.
model_def: The model's points allowed per 100 possessions, adjusted for opponents' offences (lower is better).
pace: Possessions per game: a style marker, not a strength.
efg: Shooting with threes worth 1.5 makes: the biggest of the four factors.
opp_efg: The same for opponents: shooting defence.
orb_pct: Share of its own misses the team gets back.
drb_pct: Share of opponents' misses the team secures.
net: Raw points per 100 possessions better than opponents, not schedule-adjusted.
ftr: Free throws made per field-goal attempt.
opp_ftr: Opponents' free throws made per field-goal attempt (lower is better).
tpar: Share of shots from three: a style marker.
opp_fg3: Opponents' three-point percentage: mostly luck over half a season.
pyth_wins: Wins expected from points scored and allowed.
luck: Actual wins minus Pythagorean wins: mostly close-game luck.
close_win_pct: Win % in games within 5 points: does not repeat.
